subject.title: fix(codex): keep root memory in bootstrap context

question: Should native Codex expose root `MEMORY.md` through bounded turn context by default when memory tools are available, reversing the shipped tool-routed default from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87383?
rationale: The code path is focused and appears correct, but the central choice changes prompt visibility for user-editable memory and is a compatibility/security-boundary decision that automation should not accept for maintainers.

options.title: Accept The Narrow Default Change
options.body: Merge this focused PR after owner review, keeping root `MEMORY.md` bounded in native Codex turn context while retaining memory tools for deeper recall.

options.title: Defer To Selectable Prompt Surface
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it in favor of a maintained configurable prompt-surface policy if maintainers want a compatibility-preserving option.

options.title: Keep Tool-Routed Default
options.body: Reject the default change and preserve the shipped behavior where root `MEMORY.md` is tool-routed when memory tools are available.

recommendation.title: Accept The Narrow Default Change
recommendation.body: Merge this focused PR after owner review, keeping root `MEMORY.md` bounded in native Codex turn context while retaining memory tools for deeper recall.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the shipped tool-routed memory behavior this PR reverses and is the strongest history owner for the default decision.
